toml/parse#

Immutable TOML 1.0 document representation; parsing occurs on value().

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let config = ParsedToml(text).root();
config.get("server").int("port");             // read like json (#140)
config.maybe("debug").boolean() else false;

Description#

Immutable TOML 1.0 document representation; parsing occurs on value(). Construction binds text/budgets and rejects invalid configuration only. Default bounds: 1048576 input Unicode scalars, depth 64, 10000 total nodes. Root depth is 1. Arrays/table members each add a depth level, including implicit dotted/header tables and each array-of-table element. Tables have <=1024 members and arrays <=10000 items. Explicit depth is capped at 128 to prevent host stack exhaustion. No unbounded recursive configuration. value() returns a complete nominal TomlTable, preserving insertion order; syntax/number/conflict/budget errors throw InvalidToml with source coordinates. Repeated observations are deterministic: each root() reads the text again. Returned values contain their own coordinates, so they outlive this object. No resource acquisition/close/destroy, host zone, locale or implicit output.

Strings: all four TOML forms, exact Unicode escapes, multiline CRLF -> LF, initial newline trimming and basic-string backslash line folding. Numbers: exact signed 64-bit int; finite binary64 retains signed zeros and subnormals, overflow fails. Explicit infinity/NaN use separate value objects. Temporal: validated dates/year zero, second 60 notation, fixed/unknown offset; fractions beyond nine digits truncate, never round. No instant conversion. Tables: decoded key uniqueness, sealed inline tables, dotted/table conflicts, implicit parent declarations and most-recent array-of-table binding. See docs/std/toml-parse-guide.md. This module does not write TOML documents.

Run tests as a root module, because dependency test blocks are not executed: okkama run -t std/toml/parse.ok

enum InvalidToml#

enum InvalidToml is Error = (located(offset is int, line is int, column is int, message is string))
